updates.t: In speeches during the week, Fed officials signal a rate rise in December. Governor Christopher Waller says a half-point rise should be considered, which would be double the usual step.
updates.why: A larger rise would be a stronger move against inflation than the usual quarter point.

updates.t: Minutes of the Fed’s 27–28 October meeting, released on 18 November, show that almost all officials thought further rate rises would likely be appropriate. Two members had voted for a 0.25-point rise in October, when the Fed held its rate at 3.75% to 4%.
updates.why: Markets now watch whether the Fed raises rates at its 8–9 December meeting.
